text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy after a
day out,
the sound of lively voices lures
us to the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goodness... a flea market? I see, so
that's why
so many people are here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Called it! I thought I recognized you
two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ines! Hello. Are you shopping today?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no. I'm helping out at the
market!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of stuff here, plenty of
bargains to
find.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My... There really are a lot of items for
sale here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Picture books, dolls, accessories... Hehe,
I feel as
though I'm a child in a toy store!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is that all right with you? Then yes, by
all means!
choice_data_list: せっかくだし見ていこうか
choice_data_list_en: Since we're here, let's take a look.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Take your time. If you find
anything you
like, feel free to let me
know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Everything is wonderful. I just
can't choose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Has
anything caught
your eye?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My! I had my eye on that book as well.
Every dish
looks exquisite.
choice_data_list: 『3星レストランの秘蔵レシピ』かな
『ゴールドシップのサイン色紙』かな
choice_data_list_en: Maybe 'an autograph board from Gold Ship'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Were you thinking of making something
from
this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it would be no trouble at all! You
should be
aware, however—I'm a bit
harsh when it comes to
judging flavor.
choice_data_list_en: Could you taste-test this for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you decide what to buy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we found something wonderful!
Could we get
a bag for it as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ A flea market is certainly
nothing to
sneeze at!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bwah?! Where did they get such a
thing?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's our last one! It's really
popular among
families with kids.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Believe me, though, I was shocked
myself when
Gold Ship came in to offer
them. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You... have my sympathies.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So? Should I ring you up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? May I have a word with you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want you to think this over
thoroughly...
carefully...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pressured by Mejiro McQueen, I
abandon the
idea of buying the
autograph.
